# Huron County Heating & Cooling

> Huron County Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Huron County, Huron County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Service areas: Goderich, Clinton, Exeter, Seaforth, Wingham, Bayfield, Blyth, Hensall
